about: Roles One Roof offers when you start a session: a skill plus the agent that should run it. {repo} and {workstream} are filled in for you.

roles.title: Where are we
roles.opening: Use the where-are-we skill, focused on {workstream}. Keep it short: where things stand and what is next.

roles.title: Write the spec
roles.opening: Use the write-the-spec skill in {repo} for {workstream}. Stop when the spec is ready for approval.

roles.title: Build it test-first
roles.opening: Use the test-first skill in {repo}: write failing tests for the objective below, then make them pass.

roles.title: Second opinion
roles.opening: Use the second-opinion skill on the latest changes in {repo}. Correctness first; every finding with file and line.

roles.title: Secrets check
roles.opening: Use the keep-secrets-out skill on {repo}: check the working tree and recent history, report what you find, fix only what is safe.

roles.title: Update the repo map
roles.opening: Use the repo-map skill in {repo}: bring docs/codebase-map.md up to date with the code.

roles.title: Ship it
roles.opening: Use the ship-domain skill for {repo}. Stop and ask before the production step.
